name: Nuvera Communications
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public nuvera.net pages only (no sign-in). Nuvera (formerly New Ulm Telecom; Hutchinson, Sleepy Eye and other Minnesota exchanges) bills home phone with its other services in the Nuvera Online Account (My Account > Manage Your Account), moved to a new platform for accounts opened before January 28, 2026. Registration (Create Your Account Now): first and last name, the email on the Nuvera account, a mobile number and the account number from the first bill; the password is set from an emailed link. Existing users keep their username; the identifier is inferred to be the account email. Password: at least 8 characters with three of uppercase, lowercase, numbers and listed special characters. Payments require signing in (no pay-without-login option described); Make a Payment takes credit/debit card, e-check (ACH), PayPal or Venmo (wallets not modelled). A $3.05 processing fee applies to every credit or debit card payment (one-time and recurring); ACH is free. Mail: P.O. Box 697, New Ulm, MN 56073; in person at Nuvera retail locations; drop box for paper-bill customers. Manage Autopay (left menu) sets recurring card or ACH payments; notifications are sent before autopayments. Go Paperless button next to the mailbox icon; paper invoices cost $5.00 a month; paper stops from the next cycle. Bill History shows past invoices as PDFs. Residential support 844.354.4111. Cancellation, payment arrangements and late fees are not described on the pages used (family defaults kept). Reviewed 2026-10-10 (t20 review): guest_pay evidence lowered to inferred (no page states that a pay-without-login option is absent; the support page only describes signing in first). Removed an unsourced "about a year" invoice-history claim.

help.title: Ways to pay your Nuvera bill
paragraphs: Sign in to your Nuvera account (My Account, then Manage Your Account) and select Make a Payment. You can pay by credit or debit card, e-check, PayPal or Venmo.
A $3.05 processing fee is added to every credit or debit card payment. ACH (e-check) payments have no fee.

By mail, send your bill stub and check to P.O. Box 697, New Ulm, MN 56073 with your account number on the check; don't send cash. You can also pay at a Nuvera retail location or, with a paper bill, use the drop box.

help.title: Autopay
paragraphs: Sign in and choose Manage Autopay in the left menu, then set up recurring credit/debit card or ACH payments and follow the steps. You are notified before each autopayment is processed.
Recurring card payments include the $3.05 card processing fee; choose ACH to avoid it.

help.title: Go paperless
paragraphs: Sign in and select Go Paperless next to the mailbox icon. Paper statements stop with the next billing cycle and a confirmation email goes to the main contact. You'll get an email each time a bill is ready.
Customers who keep a paper invoice pay a $5.00 monthly paper bill fee. Past invoices stay available as PDFs in Bill History.

help.title: Set up your online account
paragraphs: Select Create Your Account Now beneath the Sign In button. Enter your first and last name, the email address on your Nuvera account, a mobile number and the account number from the upper-right corner of your bill, accept the privacy policy and register. Then follow the emailed link to create your password.
Passwords need at least 8 characters and at least three of: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers and special characters.
